1	package evidence
     2	
     3	import (
     4		"bytes"
     5		"context"
     6		"errors"
     7		"fmt"
     8		"io"
     9		"path"
    10		"sort"
    11		"strconv"
    12		"strings"
    13		"unicode/utf8"
    14	)
    15	
    16	// Tool-family reduction (PAR-CTX-02). The nine xMustard tools keep the generic
    17	// xm-reduce/1 projection. Output captured from any other tool (native shell, read,
    18	// grep, list, MCP tools of other servers) is reduced by a versioned family reducer
    19	// selected from a registry keyed by the client's tool name and, for shell tools, the
    20	// command's argv0. Store.Capture reaches the selected reducer through the registry
    21	// hook in Reduce (reduce.go): the capture pipeline puts a reduceHook in the context,
    22	// so the store's retention logic is shared unchanged.
    23	
    24	// Family names one tool family.
    25	type Family string
    26	
    27	const (
    28		FamilyShell      Family = "shell"
    29		FamilyTest       Family = "test"
    30		FamilyBuild      Family = "build"
    31		FamilyLint       Family = "lint"
    32		FamilyLog        Family = "log"
    33		FamilyGit        Family = "git"
    34		FamilyDiff       Family = "diff"
    35		FamilyGrep       Family = "grep"
    36		FamilyRead       Family = "read"
    37		FamilyList       Family = "list"
    38		FamilyGlob       Family = "glob"
    39		FamilyStructured Family = "structured"
    40	)
    41	
    42	// Selector describes the tool call that produced one output.
    43	type Selector struct {
    44		Client  string // claude | codex | cursor | pi | opencode | letta | mcp | http
    45		Tool    string // the client's tool name (Bash, Read, grep, mcp__server__tool, ...)
    46		Command string // shell command line, when the tool ran one
    47		Path    string // file or directory the tool addressed
    48		// StartLine is the line number of the first captured line (a read of a range);
    49		// 0 means 1. FromLine/ToLine bound the requested range (absolute, inclusive; 0 =
    50		// open), for reads that captured more than was asked for.
    51		StartLine, FromLine, ToLine int
    52		ExitCode                    *int
    53		// Family forces a family (the caller knows, e.g., that a command ran tests).
    54		Family Family
    55	}
    56	
    57	// Section is a named byte range of one captured original (for example the stdout
    58	// and stderr strings of a decoded hook body). Offsets are absolute.
    59	type Section struct {
    60		Name  string `json:"name"`
    61		Start int64  `json:"start"`
    62		End   int64  `json:"end"`
    63		// Array marks a JSON array of strings stored one element per line (Claude
    64		// Glob/Grep filenames); its projection keeps that form.
    65		Array bool `json:"array,omitempty"`
    66		// Merged counts the output strings appended to the overflow section.
    67		Merged int `json:"merged,omitempty"`
    68		// Status marks the decoder's status line (hookbody.go StatusSection). Family
    69		// reducers never see it: every projection ends with it verbatim.
    70		Status bool `json:"status,omitempty"`
    71	}
    72	
    73	// Input is one original as a family reducer sees it.
    74	type Input struct {
    75		R           io.ReaderAt
    76		N           int64
    77		ContentType string
    78		Sel         Selector
    79		Sections    []Section // nil means one "output" section covering [0,N)
    80		Target      int       // projection budget in bytes
    81		Max         int       // hard cap in bytes
    82	}
    83	
    84	// Facts are the counts and anchors a family reducer extracted from the whole
    85	// original. They are exact for the scanned bytes, whatever the projection kept.
    86	type Facts struct {
    87		ExitCode      *int     `json:"exit_code,omitempty"`
    88		ExitFrom      string   `json:"exit_from,omitempty"` // tool (reported by the client) | text (parsed from the output)
    89		Lines         int      `json:"lines"`
    90		Passed        int      `json:"passed,omitempty"`
    91		Failed        int      `json:"failed,omitempty"`
    92		Skipped       int      `json:"skipped,omitempty"`
    93		CountsFrom    string   `json:"counts_from,omitempty"` // summary | lines
    94		FailingTests  []string `json:"failing_tests,omitempty"`
    95		FailureLines  int      `json:"failure_lines,omitempty"`
    96		FailuresShown int      `json:"failures_shown,omitempty"`
    97		Errors        int      `json:"errors,omitempty"`
    98		Warnings      int      `json:"warnings,omitempty"`
    99		Collapsed     int      `json:"collapsed_lines,omitempty"`
   100		Repeats       int      `json:"repeated_lines,omitempty"`
   101		Matches       int      `json:"matches,omitempty"`
   102		Files         int      `json:"files,omitempty"`
   103		Entries       int      `json:"entries,omitempty"`
   104		Additions     int      `json:"additions,omitempty"`
   105		Deletions     int      `json:"deletions,omitempty"`
   106		Shown         int      `json:"shown,omitempty"`
   107	
   108		sum *testSummary // counts a test runner printed (reduce_testrun.go)
   109	}
   110	
   111	// FamilyRecord is persisted with the projection record (Record.Family): which family
   112	// reducer produced it, for which client and output shape, and what it extracted.
   113	type FamilyRecord struct {
   114		Family Family `json:"family"`
   115		// Reducer is the id/version of the rule set that produced the projection text
   116		// (e.g. xm-test/1). When the selected family reducer delegated to other rules
   117		// (a diff without file headers uses xm-git rules), Selected names the family
   118		// reducer and Reducer the rules actually applied.
   119		Reducer  string    `json:"reducer"`
   120		Selected string    `json:"selected_reducer,omitempty"`
   121		Client   string    `json:"client,omitempty"`
   122		Tool     string    `json:"tool,omitempty"`
   123		Argv0    string    `json:"argv0,omitempty"`
   124		Shape    string    `json:"output_shape,omitempty"`
   125		Sections []Section `json:"sections,omitempty"`
   126		Facts    Facts     `json:"facts"`
   127		// FirstLine is the line number of the original's first line when it is not 1 (a
   128		// read of a range): the projection numbers lines from it, and search-in-original
   129		// applies it, so a "lines A-B omitted" marker is recovered with lines=A-B.
   130		FirstLine int `json:"first_line,omitempty"`
   131		// Capture is the capture metadata of a universal capture (capture_meta.go).
   132		Capture *CaptureMeta `json:"capture,omitempty"`
   133	}
   134	
   135	// CaptureMeta is the metadata of a universal capture (PAR-CTX-01, capture_meta.go),
   136	// persisted with the projection record.
   137	type CaptureMeta struct {
   138		Client           string `json:"client"`
   139		Format           string `json:"format"`
   140		Tool             string `json:"tool"`
   141		ToolVersion      string `json:"tool_version,omitempty"`
   142		CallID           string `json:"call_id,omitempty"`
   143		SessionID        string `json:"session_id,omitempty"`
   144		AgentID          string `json:"agent_id,omitempty"`
   145		TurnID           string `json:"turn_id,omitempty"`
   146		TranscriptPath   string `json:"transcript_path,omitempty"`
   147		Principal        string `json:"principal,omitempty"`
   148		ArgsDigest       string `json:"args_digest,omitempty"`
   149		IsError          bool   `json:"is_error"`
   150		ExitCode         *int   `json:"exit_code,omitempty"`
   151		ContentType      string `json:"content_type"`
   152		OutputShape      string `json:"output_shape"`
   153		HookEvent        string `json:"hook_event,omitempty"`
   154		BodySHA256       string `json:"body_sha256,omitempty"`
   155		BodyBytes        int64  `json:"body_bytes,omitempty"`
   156		CapturedIdentity string `json:"captured_identity"`
   157	}
   158	
   159	// Projection is a family reducer's result.
   160	type Projection struct {
   161		Text string // the model-facing projection of the whole original
   162		// Parts holds one projection per section, for shape adapters that rebuild a
   163		// client payload field by field (Claude Bash stdout/stderr, Read file.content).
   164		Parts map[string]string
   165		// Structured is the per-kind projection (read {path, line_count, excerpt}, list
   166		// entries, search matches) when the family defines one.
   167		Structured any
   168		Record     Record
   169		Facts      Facts
   170	}
   171	
   172	// Reducer is one versioned, deterministic projection rule set for a tool family.
   173	type Reducer interface {
   174		Family() Family
   175		ID() string
   176		Version() int
   177		Reduce(ctx context.Context, in *Input) (*Projection, error)
   178	}
   179	
   180	// reducerName is the id/version recorded with every projection.
   181	func reducerName(r Reducer) string { return r.ID() + "/" + strconv.Itoa(r.Version()) }
   182	
   183	// Registry maps tool families to their reducers.
   184	type Registry struct {
   185		byFamily map[Family]Reducer
   186	}
   187	
   188	// NewRegistry builds a registry; a later reducer for the same family replaces an
   189	// earlier one.
   190	func NewRegistry(rs ...Reducer) *Registry {
   191		g := &Registry{byFamily: map[Family]Reducer{}}
   192		for _, r := range rs {
   193			g.byFamily[r.Family()] = r
   194		}
   195		return g
   196	}
   197	
   198	// DefaultRegistry holds every built-in family reducer.
   199	func DefaultRegistry() *Registry {
   200		return NewRegistry(
   201			lineReducer{rules: shellRules}, lineReducer{rules: buildRules}, lineReducer{rules: logRules},
   202			lineReducer{rules: gitRules}, lineReducer{rules: testRules}, lintReducer{}, diffReducer{},
   203			grepReducer{}, readReducer{}, listReducer{glob: false}, listReducer{glob: true},
   204			structuredReducer{},
   205		)
   206	}
   207	
   208	// ReducerInfo describes one registered reducer.
   209	type ReducerInfo struct {
   210		Family  Family `json:"family"`
   211		Reducer string `json:"reducer"`
   212	}
   213	
   214	// Reducers lists the registered reducers in family order.
   215	func (g *Registry) Reducers() []ReducerInfo {
   216		out := make([]ReducerInfo, 0, len(g.byFamily))
   217		for f, r := range g.byFamily {
   218			out = append(out, ReducerInfo{Family: f, Reducer: reducerName(r)})
   219		}
   220		sort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Family < out[j].Family })
   221		return out
   222	}
   223	
   224	// Lookup returns the reducer for a family.
   225	func (g *Registry) Lookup(f Family) (Reducer, bool) {
   226		r, ok := g.byFamily[f]
   227		return r, ok
   228	}
   229	
   230	// Select picks the reducer for a tool call, deterministically: an explicit family,
